claim: Respondents determined by the commission in G. L. c. 151B § 5 proceedings to have committed discriminatory acts in employment are entitled to both administrative review under G. initial_reasoning: The grounding context states that respondents in § 5 proceedings are entitled only to administrative review under G. L. c. 30A and that the Lavelle holding granting a jury trial right is being overruled. The cited case, 441 Mass. 549 (the Lavelle decision), supports the opposite view, not the claim that the court affirms Lavelle. Hence the citation does not support the claim.
